title: Board time and a daily on/off schedule
summary: Read and set boot-local board time over every existing transport, schedule LEDs On at 18:00 and Off at 06:00 by default, bypass scheduling while time is invalid, and expose schedule plus enabled-by-default phone-time synchronization in APK Settings. Planning only; reconnect sync interval, time-zone/DST policy and manual on/off precedence remain owner questions.
